best_match.fbbt_definition: Any muscle cell of the adult.

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00005074 'muscle cell', a current FBbt cell term. FBbt has the adult-specific variant FBbt:00058230 'adult muscle cell', which denotes the same cells in the adult; the data are from adult flies, so the adult term is used.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Somatic, contractile cell that makes up a muscle. It is formed by several fusion events between fusion competent myoblasts and one founder cell.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: The authors' term; FBbt has the adult-specific variant, preferred because the data are from adult flies (curation rule 4).

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00058230 'adult muscle cell' (adult variant of the authors' term), exact match.
